correction_canaries.assertion: The supplied [priya] of D4 is visibly editorial: rendered in square brackets in the word line, measured into the run, with no bar, no arrows and no node index — not an ordinary constituent, not footnote-only.

The canonical uddama grouping is Leitan's {uddāma-ajñāna-rūpa} block + tail with the ‖-mark/II-часть before svabhāvā; the signed-off plate reading stays reproducible as klammerdiagramm-uddama-plate-historical.

The -e dual of the worked sentence (abhijñānaśākuntale) is labelled Acc. dual (Nom./Acc.), never locative — the documented correction in sanskrit-right-to-left-reading.md §Discipline — and the label survives browser and print rendering of the canary.
